title: Interpret the selected browser model profile
statement: The Interpretation and validation Module shall interpret the selected browser model profile within its accountable browser contribution to SR-084, retaining the stated limits of collaborating owners.

what.problem: A locally successful browser step can hide missing ownership or an invalid cross-boundary conclusion.
what.desired_outcome: Interpret the selected browser model profile.

why.rationale: MOD-003 owns the behavior necessary for the selected SR-084 criteria; the SR remains the system-wide obligation.

conditions: When generating, reading, recovering or qualifying the selected browser scope.

contexts: MOD-003 and its declared browser cooperation contracts.

how.approach: Apply the constrained Functions and preserve source, output, qualification and authority distinctions at the boundary.

how_much.scope: Contribution to SR-084 criteria 3, 5. Other Module contributions and final product qualification remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Missing, ambiguous or unsupported profile selection yields a specific diagnostic without silently applying another profile; invalid required content prevents publication of a successful snapshot.
An absent optional view fact remains an explicit absence or limitation rather than making the supported minimal model invalid.
constraints: Draft allocation; does not establish implemented browser support or requirement satisfaction.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
